 Gattuso hit by double setback, Parma and Sassuolo come too soon for Rovella and Marusic 
 Go to the comments section Add to your bookmarks Share this article Il Messaggero believes Lazio will be without Nicolo Rovella and Adam Marusic for Saturday's home game against Parma and Tuesday's trip to Sassuolo.
 According to The Laziali, Gennaro Gattuso is taking a safety-first approach to returns. Marusic has been out since a hamstring injury on the opening day at Bologna, while Rovella hurt a calf the following week against former club Genoa.
 OneFootball Videos
 Club doctor Pietro Monachino said both players are following an agreed schedule, working on the pitch but apart from the group. He described steady progress and a measured recovery, supported by staff who put the player first.
 No specific return date was given. The pair will instead aim to be available for the following weekend's meeting with Napoli.
 Monachino added that Albert Gudmundsson's shoulder fracture is healing well, though Il Messaggero expects him to remain out at least until the start of December. The boost for Gattuso is Matteo Cancellieri has recovered from a knee problem and is available to face former club Parma.
 Source: The Laziali
